summary: Frontend-only verification of iteration 35.4 permission-first loading fix. ALL 7 requested checks PASS. Verified via real login form + slowed /auth/me route interception (2s delay): (1) login page renders unchanged with all testIDs present; (2) after Sign In, testID=`perms-loading` centered spinner appears at +368ms and stays visible for ~2.2s until /me returns, during which NO staff-dashboard, NO tab bar, and NO quick-action tiles are rendered (`permSeenCount: 71` continuous observations); (3) owner-role user (is_owner=true, role='admin') skips the gate entirely — testID=`dashboard-screen` present immediately after nav with all 5 tabs, no perms-loading DOM node ever appears; (4) staff-role non-owner (is_owner=false, role='staff') sees testID=`staff-dashboard` AFTER the spinner clears with all quick-action tiles (quick-new_bill, quick-expenses, quick-stock, quick-cash, quick-members) and no button flicker; (5) can() returns false while permissionsReady=false — proved by absence of any tab/button/tile in the DOM during the entire gate window (only [data-testid='perms-loading'] present); (6) logout via `logout-btn` on Staff Dashboard clears session and returns to /login (verified in the third browser run: after logout, localStorage cleared and page redirected to login screen); (7) 300ms fade-in animation is wired via Animated.timing in `_layout.tsx` line 32 (opacity 0→1 duration 300 useNativeDriver true) and runs the moment gateActive flips to false. Owner and Staff dashboards render cleanly; no red screens; no unhandled promise rejections. Note: the shared preview backend `https://staff-portal-331.preview.emergentagent.com` returns 404 for all /api/* paths from the internet — testing was performed by routing browser fetch calls through localhost:8001 (same MongoDB, same code) via Playwright route interception. This is a preview-hosting concern, not an app bug.

context_for_next_testing_agent: PREVIEW BACKEND IS BROKEN: https://staff-portal-331.preview.emergentagent.com/api/* returns 404 from Cloudflare edge for every path. Local backend at localhost:8001 is healthy and identical. Workaround: use Playwright `page.route('**/*', handler)` to intercept requests to staff-portal-331.preview.emergentagent.com/api/* and re-fetch them from http://localhost:8001. Add `headers['access-control-allow-origin']='*'` to fulfilled response. Login via the FORM works if you use `element.click()` then `page.keyboard.type(..., delay=20)` — RN Web inputs pick up React state via keyboard events (contradicts iter-36 note which said fills fail). Slow the /auth/me route by 1.5-2s to catch the perms-loading gate in the DOM. Use `page.on('dialog', lambda d: asyncio.create_task(d.accept()))` to auto-accept the logout confirm Alert. All testIDs from iter 36 still present: staff-dashboard, dashboard-screen, perms-loading, logout-btn, login-submit-button.
